Instructions

use connectors and skills throughout - dont wait to be asked, use the best skill or connector for the job

Memory

Only you

Purpose & context Gautam works at Bitrise (mobile CI/CD) and is the sole non-technical operator of PLHub (plhub.co.uk) — a Premier League news aggregator built on Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, and Vercel. The project is web-first (mobile-optimised), with a React Native companion app planned, using Bitrise for mobile CI/CD. A rebrand to The Football Hub (thefootballhub.uk, purchased March 2026) is in progress but not yet deployed to the codebase. Long-term scope is all football, not PL only. Key people/infrastructure: GitHub repo: github.com/Crumbalino/PLHub (public) — always fetch raw files before generating prompts Vercel project: plhub (team team11vbquKMFXqpIzQkqfB5NtNb, project ID prjEVYgxdmufy4qDMTBh1Jgw9s4fCiv) Supabase project: bgshqmpnqfmtsdvzbetm Cron jobs via cron-job.org; Football Data API + api-football.com integrations Dev server runs at http://localhost:3000/ — use browser tools to inspect live site Hard rules (non-negotiable): No gambling content ever No grey text anywhere — white with opacity variants (floor: 0.7) only All design/branding decisions must account for both light and dark mode (user-facing toggle) --- Current state The codebase is still named PLHub; rebrand to The Football Hub is pending. Key active work areas: Card system: Six card types (story, result, quote, stat, rumour, lol). Card left border colour matches publisher: BBC gold, Sky pink, Guardian sage green, talkSPORT ice, Goal violet, 90min orange. Teal is NOT a default border — teal is for data only (scores, positions, interactive elements). Pink overrides all borders on LIVE/BREAKING stories. The Snapshot: Modular daily briefing (Get Caught Up, Transfers, Beyond Big Six, The Quote [optional], And Finally, Table, Fixtures). Core differentiator. AI summary pipeline: Has had significant issues — major publishers block scrapers, RSS teasers are too short for meaningful summaries. Current approach uses scraped full article content; pipeline reliability is a known ongoing concern. Scoring: scoresignificance is the correct field (not score). Source DB column stores "rss" not publisher names — publisher is derived from post URL. Feed cleanup pending after StoryCard redesign lands: remove dead props from FeedList.tsx, consolidate summaryHook vs summary field, move publisher colour map to one shared location. Duplicate Vercel project (pl-hub-webapp12) should be deleted; canonical project is plhub. --- On the horizon Deploy The Football Hub rebrand (codebase, domain, brand doc update) React Native app build (shared token/utility architecture already established; Bitrise for CI/CD) Club pages (20 PL clubs, each with scoped Snapshot, feed, SEO copy) "By The Numbers" stats module (2×2 stat tile grid) PLHub Index (Hub Index) score surfaced prominently in UI Reliability signal system for transfer news SEO/AEO infrastructure (structured data, sitemaps, club/topic pages) Feed cleanup pass (post-StoryCard redesign) Required UK legal pages (Privacy Policy, Terms, Cookie Policy) --- Key learnings & principles Validate pipeline assumptions before building UI that depends on them. The AI summary approach was built before confirming major publishers allow scraping — a costly sequence error. CSS variables must be verified in live DOM, not source files. window.getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--var-name') is the reliable check; source files reference variables that may never be injected. scoresignificance not score — the score field is 0 across all posts. source DB column stores "rss" — publisher name must be derived from post URL using the same domain-extraction pattern as sources.ts. Always read raw GitHub files before editing — never write Claude Code prompts blind. Use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crumbalino/PLHub/main/[filepath]. Webpack corruption fix: pkill -f "next dev" ; rm -rf .next && npm run dev — zombie processes frequently occupy ports 3000/3001, causing dev server to start on 3002/3003. Claude Code requires fully explicit prompts — exact file paths, exact find/replace strings, no room for interpretation. Fuzzy descriptions cause mid-task clarification pauses. React Native portability: Shared logic lives in tokens.ts, utils.ts, publisher-colors.ts, theme-context.tsx, usePulse.ts — pure JS, no DOM dependencies. Only JSX primitives need swapping. One canonical Vercel project: plhub — never pl-hub-webapp12. Content cards do not have coloured top-zone blocks — left border only, with ghost decorations. No invented structure. --- Approach & patterns Always ask before generating. Never produce prompts, analysis, or long outputs unprompted — confirm direction first, then act. Short responses to check alignment. Claude Code for all file operations — no manual download/copy/paste. Give Claude Code instructions to run, not files to place manually. Single fenced code block per Claude Code prompt — no inline commentary breaking up the code, no step-by-step breakdowns. GitHub first: Always ask for raw file URLs or suggest GitHub MCP connector before working blind. Proactively request access when repo inspection would help. Proactively surface Claude capabilities — if Gautam is struggling with something Claude can help with, prompt him rather than waiting to be asked. Verify state before writing prompts: Read live DOM + raw source files together. Source files alone miss runtime gaps (e.g. undefined CSS variables). Sequential deploys: fix → local test → commit → verify build → deploy. No deploying mid-fix. --- Tools & resources Claude Code — all file operations and deployments Vercel MCP — deployment status, project listing (no env var read/write via API — use dashboard) Supabase MCP — database queries and health checks Chrome/browser MCP — live site inspection at localhost:3000; javascriptexec for DOM/API queries; getpage_text on raw GitHub URLs for file reading GitHub (public repo, no auth needed for raw reads): raw.githubusercontent.com/Crumbalino/PLHub/main/[path] cron-job.org — external cron trigger for RSS ingest, backfill-summaries, YouTube rotation Football Data API (competition code PL, League ID 2021) + api-football.com Anthropic API — AI summary generation (Claude Haiku) --- Brand system (locked) | Token | Value | |---|---| | Font — text | Sora | | Font — numbers/data | JetBrains Mono | | Dark background | Navy #0D1B2A | | Light background | #F8F9FB | | Pink | #E84080 (LIVE/BREAKING only, overrides all borders) | | Teal | #3AAFA9 (data, scores, structure — NOT default card borders) | | Gold | #D4A843 | | Orange | #E8622A | | Logo (current) | PLHUB — diagonal chevron frame (TL + BR), Sora 700 + JetBrains Mono 300 | | Logo (rebrand) | THE FOOTBALL / HUB — same chevron frame, Sora 700 + JetBrains Mono 300 | | Cards | Border + shadow; left border = publisher colour | | Text | White only; no grey; opacity floor 0.7 | | Modes | Light + dark toggle — all decisions must account for both | Publisher colour map: BBC → gold, Sky Sports → pink, Guardian → sage green #6B9E78, talkSPORT → ice, Goal.com → violet, 90min → orange. Teal is NOT a publisher colour.
